_comment_variant: HYDRA Variant F — Ghauri 0DTE Mean Reversion Credit Spreads. Fades price touching the day's VIX-implied expected-move boundary with a ONE-SIDED (never both) 0DTE SPX put or call credit vertical — never holds overnight, so STATE-004 never applies. dry-run-LOCKED (GhauriMeanReversionStrategy refuses non-dry_run construction) — going live is a deliberate later operator decision, not a config flip. See bots/hydra/ghauri_strategy.py's module docstring + the approved build plan for the full design (7 fully self-contained method overrides, zero edits to shared strategy.py/base_strategy.py). NOTE: this checked-in file is a sample/template, not deploy-authoritative — the VM's live copy is edited directly there (see CLAUDE.md Config Files) and may diverge from this value.

strategy.name: ghauri
strategy._comment_commission: IBKR all-in SPX cost ~$1.15/leg/contract — see config_variant_c.json's comment for the full breakdown.
strategy._comment_entry_times: Not read for scheduling by this strategy — GhauriMeanReversionStrategy fully overrides _parse_entry_times/_should_attempt_entry/_skip_missed_entries/_is_entry_time and never consults this list for control flow. Left here only so a human skimming this file isn't confused by its absence; the real trigger config is the ghauri block below.
strategy._comment_ghauri: The strategy's own knobs. target_delta_pct/delta_band drive shared/delta_strike_selector.py's walk; width_pt is the long-leg offset from the selected short strike; pct_of_credit + trail_* drive ghauri_strategy.py's self-contained stop/take-profit/trail logic (see its module docstring for the corrected stop-formula rationale). trail_lock_pct=0.0 means the trail locks in breakeven once armed (the most conservative reading of the source strategy's ambiguous 'breakeven or +10%' language) — raise toward 0.10 to lock a small guaranteed profit instead, once real dry-run data suggests which reading fits better.
strategy._comment_decay_off: Explicitly null (not omitted) — a present-but-null key still returns None from strategy_cfg.get(...), so this overrides HydraStrategy's own config-read default and forces _get_effective_stop_level's MKT-042 decay branch off entirely. Required: this strategy's trail-to-breakeven tightens the stop mid-life, and decay would re-widen it back out (the same 'L-C2c trap' A2/narrow_spread_stop was built to avoid) if left on.
strategy._comment_narrow_spread_stop_off: Not used by this strategy (it never calls _calculate_stop_levels_hydra) — left disabled for clarity/self-documentation, not because anything reads it.
strategy._comment_max_vix_entry: Ghauri's own entry logic has no VIX cutoff (matches CLAUDE.md's framing for A: neither Sandvand nor this strategy's own rules gate entry on a VIX ceiling) — set to the same effective-disable sentinel A/B/C use.
strategy._comment_safety_caps: Conservative sizing at 1c while this variant is dry-run-locked and under initial observation — matches variant A's ORDER-006 defaults, not B/C's narrow-spread sizing (this isn't a narrow-spread strategy).
strategy._comment_mkt046: 2026-08-28: same disable as B/C (see config_variant_b.json's comment + bots/hydra/__init__.py version history) — MKT-046's 10s wait isn't part of Ghauri's own design and was never validated for it; disabling here matches the same reasoning (not from any strategy's original research) rather than F's own stop history, which is essentially nonexistent (dry-run-locked, first live day 2026-08-28). Zero real-money risk either way.
strategy._comment_fomc: CORRECTED (found by adversarial post-implementation review — the original comment here was wrong): fomc_t1_skip_enabled and fomc_t1_callonly_enabled genuinely have no effect on this variant, since both live inside HydraStrategy._initiate_entry, which GhauriMeanReversionStrategy overrides completely and never calls into. fomc_announcement_skip is DIFFERENT — it's read by the base MEICStrategy.run_strategy_check (base_strategy.py, the main-loop entry point Ghauri does NOT override) and, if true on an FOMC announcement day, sets state=DAILY_COMPLETE and skips the ENTIRE day before this class's own logic ever runs. Deliberately set false here (trade normally on announcement day, matching D/E's own convention) — this is a real, live, config-controlled choice, not an inert leftover. Flipping it to true would genuinely skip Ghauri on FOMC days.
strategy._comment_calm_and_whipsaw: Also inert for the same reason as the FOMC comment above (both live inside the overridden _initiate_entry) — set to their disabling null values anyway for clarity, since a calm-entry/anti-whipsaw filter is philosophically opposed to this strategy's entire premise of entering right at a large-move boundary.
